introduction: A new root-module package `workspace` owns the containment boundary, the ignore rules and the directory walk that every agentkit scenario opens first. The built-in tools (`tools.For`), the reference engine (`tools.References`), the code-search index and the sandbox tree are built for a `*workspace.Workspace`, so ignore configuration is given once to `workspace.Open`. The `tools` API breaks on purpose; no tool, walk or containment check changes behaviour.

glossary.MODULES: The list of Go modules in the Makefile over which make test, make vet, make lint and make tidy run.
glossary.exported-API golden: internal/policy/testdata/exported-api.golden, the recorded exported API of the packages in apiPackages, checked by TS-13-67 and regenerated when AGENTKIT_UPDATE_API_GOLDEN=1.
glossary.global layer: The lowest-precedence ignore layer, read from the file named by git's core.excludesFile; workspace.NoGlobalExcludes() makes it empty.
glossary.ignore rules: The layered gitignore-style exclusions of a workspace: the global excludes file (core.excludesFile), .git/info/exclude, then .gitignore files from the scan root down; the last matching pattern wins, and `.git` segments are always excluded.
glossary.nested-repository boundary: A directory containing `.git` below the scan root; ignore files above it stop applying and a new ignore root starts there.
glossary.scan root: The directory where the ignore engine starts loading .gitignore files: the `sub` argument of Walk, or the workspace root for Ignored.
glossary.tool digest: The hash of a tool's definition computed by sandbox/internal/tooldigest, compared between host and sandbox agent to decide compatibility.
glossary.workspace: A *workspace.Workspace returned by workspace.Open: an absolute, symlink-resolved root plus the ignore rules that apply under it. Immutable after Open.

requirements.title: Opening a workspace
requirements.rationale: Every scenario starts from a workspace whose root was resolved exactly once and cannot be forged.

criteria.condition: a caller invokes workspace.Open(root, opts) with a non-empty root that exists
criteria.action: return a *Workspace whose Root() is the absolute path of root with every symlink resolved
criteria.contract: (*Workspace, nil); Root() equals filepath.EvalSymlinks(filepath.Abs(root))

criteria.condition: a caller invokes workspace.Open with an empty root
criteria.action: use the process working directory as the root, resolved as in 20-REQ-1.1
criteria.contract: (*Workspace, nil); Root() equals the symlink-resolved os.Getwd()

criteria.condition: a caller invokes workspace.Open with a root that does not exist
criteria.action: keep the root in its lexical absolute form and report no error
criteria.contract: (*Workspace, nil); Root() equals filepath.Abs(root)

criteria.condition: the process working directory or the absolute form of root cannot be determined
criteria.action: return no workspace and the underlying error
criteria.contract: (nil, non-nil error)

criteria.action: read no ignore file and start no subprocess during Open
declare Workspace with no exported fields and Options with exactly one field, Ignore of type IgnoreOptions, whose zero value reads the real ignore environment including global excludes

for any number of goroutines calling Root, Resolve, Rel, CheckWriteTarget, Ignore, Walk and Ignored on one *Workspace concurrently, return the same results as sequential calls and report no data race under go test -race

requirements.title: Containment and normalization move unchanged
requirements.rationale: The move is about placement; the security boundary must behave exactly as the tools version did.

criteria.condition: a caller invokes (*Workspace).Resolve(p) with a path that resolves inside the root
criteria.action: normalize p before canonicalizing it, join a relative result to Root(), resolve symlinks against the deepest existing ancestor, follow dangling links to their targets, and compare containment segment by segment
criteria.contract: (contained absolute path, nil)

criteria.condition: Resolve or CheckWriteTarget is given a path whose resolved target lies outside the root, including a path made of a component swapped for an outward symlink after Resolve (CheckWriteTarget re-resolves the whole path)
criteria.action: refuse the path
criteria.contract: error wrapping workspace.ErrPathNotAllowed whose text starts with "workspace: path_not_allowed", names the root, and ends with "; use a path inside the workspace (a relative path is resolved against the root)"

criteria.condition: Normalize or Resolve is given an empty path, a path containing a NUL byte, a non-local file:// URL, `~user` for an unknown user, or a symlink chain longer than 40 hops
criteria.action: refuse the path
criteria.contract: error wrapping workspace.ErrPathMalformed whose text starts with "workspace: path_malformed"

criteria.condition: a path starting with `~` or `~/` is normalized while the home directory cannot be resolved
criteria.action: refuse the path instead of falling back to a relative path
criteria.contract: error wrapping workspace.ErrNoHome whose text starts with "workspace: home directory could not be resolved"

criteria.condition: Normalize is given `~`, `~/x`, `~user/x`, `@x` or a quoted path
criteria.action: expand the home directory or the named user's home, strip the leading `@` and the quotes, and return the rewritten path
criteria.contract: (rewritten path, nil), identical to the string tools.Normalize returned before this change

criteria.action: make Rel(abs) return abs relative to Root() when abs lies under the root and return abs unchanged otherwise, never failing

criteria.condition: a built-in file tool receives a path that the workspace refuses as outside the root
criteria.action: fail the tool call without touching the file
criteria.contract: core.ErrResult with result code "path_not_allowed" and the workspace error text

requirements.title: The workspace owns its ignore rules
requirements.rationale: Ignore configuration is given once, and the git subprocess it may need is paid at most once per workspace.

criteria.action: declare IgnoreOptions with fields Getenv func(string) string, Home func() (string, error) and GitConfig func() string, where a nil GitConfig runs `git config --path --get core.excludesFile`, and make NoGlobalExcludes() return options whose global layer is empty
criteria.contract: NoGlobalExcludes() returns IgnoreOptions whose GitConfig returns ""

criteria.action: run at most one core.excludesFile lookup per workspace over its lifetime, including when several goroutines first use its rules at once, and run none before the rules are first used

criteria.condition: a caller invokes (*Workspace).Ignore()
criteria.action: return the workspace's IgnoreOptions with GitConfig memoized, so that passing them on (for example to sandbox.LocalDir.Ignore) and using them runs no further lookup
criteria.contract: IgnoreOptions whose GitConfig returns the same value on every call and invokes the underlying lookup at most once

criteria.action: apply ignore sources from lowest precedence: the global excludes file, `.git/info/exclude`, then `.gitignore` files from the scan root down, with the last matching pattern winning so that a `!` pattern re-includes
start a new ignore root at every directory containing `.git`, always ignore any path with a `.git` segment, and never read `.ignore` files as a source

requirements.title: Walking a workspace
requirements.rationale: One walk with the workspace's rules replaces tools.Walk and its per-call ignore options.

criteria.condition: a caller invokes (*Workspace).Walk(ctx, sub, opts, fn) with sub equal to "" or "." (the root), a relative path (joined to the root) or an absolute path, that after cleaning lies within the root segment by segment
criteria.action: call fn for every entry under sub that the workspace's rules do not exclude, with rel slash-separated and relative to sub, and with the ignore engine rooted at sub so that .gitignore files above sub do not apply while the global layer and `.git/info/exclude` do
criteria.contract: nil error after all calls; the visited set equals what tools.Walk visited before this change for the same tree and options

criteria.condition: sub lies outside the root after cleaning, or the receiver is nil
criteria.action: return before calling fn
criteria.contract: error wrapping workspace.ErrPathNotAllowed; fn is called zero times

criteria.action: during Walk, skip dot-prefixed entries unless opts.IncludeHidden is set, not follow symlinks, skip unreadable entries without error, and check sub lexically without normalizing or symlink-resolving it
criteria.contract: an unreadable entry yields no fn call for it and Walk still returns nil

criteria.condition: Walk is given a sub that does not exist or that names a regular file
criteria.action: make no calls to fn
criteria.contract: nil error

criteria.condition: ctx is cancelled or past its deadline while Walk runs
criteria.action: stop at the next entry without calling fn for it
criteria.contract: returns ctx.Err()

criteria.condition: fn returns an error
criteria.action: skip the directory on filepath.SkipDir, stop without error on filepath.SkipAll, and stop on any other error
criteria.contract: nil for SkipDir and SkipAll; the error fn returned otherwise

criteria.action: declare WalkOptions with exactly one field, IncludeHidden bool, and always apply the workspace's own ignore rules in Walk

requirements.title: Asking whether a path is ignored
requirements.rationale: Callers that filter candidate files (such as the index-candidate filter) need the same answer a root walk gives, without walking.

criteria.condition: a caller invokes (*Workspace).Ignored(rel, isDir) with a workspace-relative path using either separator
criteria.action: report whether rel or any ancestor directory of rel is excluded, matching each ancestor against the ignore files of the directories above it loaded from the root down and honouring nested-repository boundaries
criteria.contract: true when rel or an ancestor is excluded, false otherwise

criteria.condition: Ignored is given a rel containing a `.git` segment
criteria.action: report the path as ignored
criteria.contract: true

criteria.condition: Ignored is given "" or "."
criteria.action: report the root as not ignored
criteria.contract: false

criteria.condition: Ignored is given an absolute path or a path that escapes the root after cleaning
criteria.action: fail closed
criteria.contract: true

criteria.action: not report a dot-prefixed name as ignored on account of its leading dot

read the .gitignore files of rel's ancestor directories and the repository exclude files on every Ignored call and keep no cache between calls, so a .gitignore edited between two calls changes the second answer

for any tree without unreadable entries, including nested .gitignore files, negations and nested repositories, make the set of entries visited by ws.Walk(ctx, "", WalkOptions{IncludeHidden: true}, fn) equal the set of filepath.WalkDir entries under the root for which Ignored(rel, d.IsDir()) is false

requirements.title: Tools are built for a workspace
requirements.rationale: The workspace becomes an argument instead of an option, and every tool walk uses its rules.

criteria.condition: a caller invokes tools.For(ws, opts) with a non-nil workspace and no Index
criteria.action: return read_file, write_file, edit_file, list_files, find_files, search_files, file_outline, find_symbol, find_references, execute and run_command in that order, with names, descriptions, input and output schemas, guidelines and execution modes byte-identical to what tools.All returned before this change
criteria.contract: ([]core.Tool of length 11, nil)

criteria.action: for every tool tools.For returns, produce a sandbox/internal/tooldigest digest equal to the digest of the same tool before this change

criteria.condition: opts.Index is set
criteria.action: append Index.Tools() after the eleven built-ins and fail with today's duplicate-name error when an index tool reuses a name
criteria.contract: (built-ins followed by index tools, nil), or (nil, duplicate-name error)

criteria.condition: tools.For is called with a nil workspace
criteria.action: return no tools and not fall back to the working directory
criteria.contract: (nil, error whose text names the missing workspace)

criteria.action: declare tools.Options with SpillDir, DisableSpill, Env, Symbols and Index and today's defaults and without Workspace or Ignore fields, derive the default spill directory from a hash of ws.Root() so the same root yields the same directory, and keep the individual tool constructors unexported
run execute and run_command with ws.Root() as their working directory

make every directory walk the tools perform (find_files, search_files, the symbol-table build and refresh, the reference engine's Go package load and candidate scan, and the filter over an index's candidate files) go through ws.Walk or ws.Ignored with the workspace's ignore rules
run at most one core.excludesFile lookup across all walks made by a tool set built from one workspace

requirements.title: References and the search entry points
requirements.rationale: The reference engine moves off the containment type, and the root-path search functions keep their shape.

criteria.condition: a caller invokes tools.References(ctx, ws, target, opts) with a non-nil workspace
criteria.action: run one reference pass bounded by the default SymbolOptions, with no reference cache and no index
criteria.contract: (ReferenceResult, nil) equal to what (*tools.Workspace).References returned before this change for the same tree and target

criteria.condition: tools.References is called with a nil workspace
criteria.action: return without searching
criteria.contract: (empty ReferenceResult, non-nil error)

criteria.condition: tools.References is called with an opts.Path outside the workspace
criteria.action: return without searching
criteria.contract: (empty ReferenceResult, error wrapping workspace.ErrPathNotAllowed)

criteria.condition: the context passed to tools.References is cancelled
criteria.action: stop the pass
criteria.contract: returns the context's error

criteria.action: keep tools.Search(ctx, root, p), tools.SearchIn(ctx, root, p, ig) and tools.CountCandidates(ctx, root, p) with root-path signatures and unchanged results, with SearchIn's ig typed workspace.IgnoreOptions, walking root through a workspace opened at root with those options
keep ReferenceOptions, ReferenceSite and ReferenceResult unchanged

requirements.title: Old names removed and the package graph enforced
requirements.rationale: Compile errors at every old call site make the migration complete, and workspace must never depend on first-party packages.

criteria.action: declare none of tools.Workspace, tools.NewWorkspace, tools.Walk, tools.WalkOptions, tools.IgnoreOptions, tools.NoGlobalExcludes, tools.Normalize, tools.ErrPathNotAllowed, tools.ErrPathMalformed, tools.ErrNoHome, tools.All, tools.Options.Workspace, tools.Options.Ignore or (*tools.Workspace).References, as a type, alias, variable or forwarding function
declare no Ignore field in codesearch.Options
import only standard-library packages and github.com/bmatcuk/doublestar/v4 from its non-test files, carrying private copies of the error-tolerant doublestar.Match wrapper and the hidden-name test
criteria.contract: go list -f '{{.Imports}}' over the package's non-test files lists only standard-library paths and github.com/bmatcuk/doublestar/v4

criteria.condition: a non-test file of package workspace imports a package outside the standard library and github.com/bmatcuk/doublestar/v4
criteria.action: fail
criteria.contract: go test failure naming the offending file and import path

criteria.action: have tools import workspace, keep MatchGlob and ExpandBraces in tools, and have the root agentkit package import neither tools nor workspace in non-test code

requirements.title: Every consumer in the repository is migrated
requirements.rationale: The index and the sandbox are built for a workspace too, and the host-agent compatibility contract must survive the rename.

criteria.action: declare New(ws *workspace.Workspace, opts Options) (tools.Index, error) in both index.go and stub_windows.go, and run the build walk and the revalidation walk through ws.Walk with the workspace's rules
criteria.contract: New returns (tools.Index, nil) for a non-nil workspace on both index.go and stub_windows.go builds

criteria.condition: codesearch.New is called with a nil workspace
criteria.action: return no index
criteria.contract: (nil, the same error text as before this change)

criteria.action: for any tree, index exactly the set of files that ws.Walk visits from the root with IncludeHidden false
type sandbox.LocalDir.Ignore and internal/rsyncx.RuleOptions.Ignore as workspace.IgnoreOptions with unchanged semantics, and make rsyncx's visitFrom walk through workspace.Open and Walk

build its tool set with tools.For over a workspace opened at its root with workspace.NoGlobalExcludes() and its explicit environment, through a build seam that takes the workspace and the options, and keep NoGlobalExcludes for its rsync rules
build internal/attach's host tools and internal/fakeagent's tools with tools.For over a throwaway workspace opened with NoGlobalExcludes, and walk internal/treegen through workspace

criteria.condition: a host built from this change attaches to a sandbox agent, including an agent whose tool definitions were recorded before this change
criteria.action: compare host-side and agent-side tool digests and accept the agent
criteria.contract: attach succeeds with no sandbox.ErrToolMismatch

criteria.action: leave every .proto file and sandbox.ProtocolMinor (2) unchanged, compile every module in MODULES and the examples against the new names (examples/codemode with its workspace() helper renamed, examples/codemode and examples/codingagent using workspace.Open and tools.For), and pass make check

requirements.title: API golden and build budgets
requirements.rationale: The change detector must track the moved declarations, and the frozen-hash invariant from spec 13 is retired. Documentation, the 13_sandbox_core erratum entry and the make doc output are task steps rather than criteria, because the steering forbids tests of docs.

criteria.action: include "workspace" in apiPackages and pass TS-13-67 against a committed exported-api.golden that was regenerated with AGENTKIT_UPDATE_API_GOLDEN=1 and records the exported API of tools and workspace
remove the goldenSHA13 hash comparisons from TS-14-44, TS-15-42 and TS-17-61, while those tests keep comparing the current API to the golden and TS-17-61 keeps its guard API check
pass TS-19-64, with internal/policy/testdata matching the last commit and ProtocolMinor equal to "2"
stay at or under TS-12-14's budget of 20,000 lines

execution_paths.title: An embedder opens a workspace and a model lists files through find_files

steps.action: calls tools.For(ws, tools.Options{}) and receives the eleven built-in tools
calls find_files with a path and a glob
resolves the path with ws.Resolve and walks it with ws.Walk using the workspace's ignore rules
returns the matching non-ignored files and refuses a path outside the root with result code path_not_allowed

execution_paths.title: An embedder builds a code-search index for a workspace and searches through it

steps.action: opens a workspace and calls codesearch.New(ws, codesearch.Options{})
builds its file set by walking the root with ws.Walk
calls tools.For(ws, tools.Options{Index: idx}) and receives the built-ins followed by the index's tools
filters the index's candidate files with ws.Ignored and returns matches only from non-ignored files

execution_paths.title: A host syncs a local directory into a sandbox and attaches to its agent

steps.action: opens a workspace and creates a sandbox with a sandbox.LocalDir whose Ignore is ws.Ignore()
builds transfer rules by walking the directory through workspace.Open and Walk with those options
opens a workspace at its root with workspace.NoGlobalExcludes() and builds its tools with tools.For
builds host tools with tools.For over a throwaway workspace and compares tool digests with the agent's
accepts the agent and exposes its tools to the caller

execution_paths.title: An embedder finds the references of a declaration

steps.action: opens a workspace and picks an outline.Decl as the target
loads Go packages and scans candidates through ws.Walk and ws.Ignored with default SymbolOptions bounds
returns a ReferenceResult listing the reference sites

symbols.name: Match
symbols.notes: Signature taken from the compiling call site in tools/glob.go (globMatch); the module source is outside the repository. workspace carries a private copy of globMatch that treats an error as no match.
